findings.fix: Review the seven undisplayed removal items against the current files and docs/audit/recovery/web-to-markdown/record.md; restore unexplained substantive content or add valid item-specific or section-specific record rows.

findings.evidence: The output evals cover several URLs targeting one file, but not two different pages resolving to the same auto-named path.
findings.fix: Add a batch eval with duplicate page titles and assert that neither result overwrites the other and that the resulting files are validated.

findings.evidence: "rerun once with `--wait-until domcontentloaded --wait-ms 2000`" conflicts with "with no known selector, do not invent one and report the extraction failure."
findings.fix: Clarify that a timeout or thin result gets the single bounded retry without `--wait-for` when no selector is known; report failure only if that retry fails.

findings.evidence: "Keep a result only when it passes: a heading plus several sentences of body" rejects a legitimate short article or page whose substantive content has fewer sentences.
findings.fix: Use page identity and task-appropriate substantive content as the pass criteria rather than requiring several sentences; report uncertainty when a short result cannot be distinguished from an incomplete extraction.

findings.evidence: "Run ... `--out ./page.md`" precedes validation, while step 5 says "Keep a result only when it passes" without a safe publication or cleanup procedure.
findings.fix: Write file-mode results and retries to distinct temporary paths, validate them, then publish to the requested destination with overwrite authorization; on failure retain or remove temporary files according to user approval and report that no validated output was published.
